description.label: Description
description.value:
Novice: Your fists burn like fire to your enemies, as your strikes following the Path of Flame cause massive internal bleeding. After a successful Unarmed strike, your opponent must roll a Challenging (+0) Opposed Strength/Toughness test or take 1 Bleed Condition. These Bleeds do not have the 10% chance of death.

Apprentice: When you successfully strike the body with your Unarmed attacks and deal Bleed, you may deal your additional +SL in Bleed Conditions against your enemy instead of Damage.

Journeyman: You gain the +2 Implacable Talent.

Master: As an action, you may spend all your Advantage

(minimum 3) to deal a deadly strike after a successful Opposed WS Test against your enemies that deals their (Number of Bleed Conditions) x2 in Damage that cannot be resisted by Armor or their TB.
